theorem exists_approx2 (α : ℝ) {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x) {Q : ℝ} (hQ : 1 ≤ Q) :
    ∃ (δ : ℝ) (a : ℤ) (q : ℕ), Approx2 α x δ a q Q := by
  set n := ⌊Q⌋₊
  have hn : 0 < n := Nat.floor_pos.2 hQ
  obtain ⟨r, hr, hrden⟩ := Real.exists_rat_abs_sub_le_and_den_le (2 * α) hn
  have hq1 : 1 ≤ r.den := r.den_pos
  have hq0 : (0 : ℝ) < r.den := by exact_mod_cast hq1
  have hcast : (r : ℝ) = r.num / r.den := Rat.cast_def r
  refine ⟨x * (2 * α - r.num / r.den), r.num, r.den, hq1, ?_, ⟨0, ?_⟩, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [Int.isCoprime_iff_gcd_eq_one]; exact r.reduced
  · field_simp; push_cast; ring
  · rw [mul_div_cancel_left₀ _ hx.ne', ← hcast]
    refine hr.trans ?_
    apply one_div_le_one_div_of_le (by positivity)
    rw [mul_comm (r.den : ℝ)]
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (Nat.lt_floor_add_one Q).le hq0.le
  · exact le_trans (by exact_mod_cast hrden) (Nat.floor_le (by linarith))

proof_context.conclusion: Dirichlet: for Q ≥ 1 there are δ, a, q with `Approx2 α x δ a q Q`, i.e. 2α = a/q + δ/x (mod 1), q ≤ Q, |δ/x| ≤ 1/(qQ).

have hα : α = m / (2 * q) + δ / (2 * y) := by
    have : α = (a / q + δ / y + k) / 2 := by linarith
    rw [this, hm]; push_cast
    field_simp; ring
  -- `|δ/(2y)| < δ₀ r/(2 q y)`
  have hrad : |δ / (2 * y)| < δ₀ * r / (2 * q * y) := by
    rw [abs_div, abs_of_pos (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) < 2 * y), div_lt_div_iff₀ (by positivity)
      (by positivity)]
    nlinarith
  have hmem : ∀ (c ρ : ℝ), |α - c| < ρ → α ∈ Set.Ioo (c - ρ) (c + ρ) := fun c ρ h => by
    rw [abs_lt] at h; constructor <;> linarith
  by_cases hpar : Odd q ∧ Even m
  · obtain ⟨hqo, b, hb⟩ := hpar
    left
    refine Set.mem_iUnion₂.2 ⟨q, ⟨hq1, hqr, hqo⟩, Set.mem_iUnion₂.2 ⟨b, ?_, hmem _ _ ?_⟩⟩
    · have : IsCoprime (2 * b) (q : ℤ) := by rw [two_mul, ← hb]; exact hcopm
      exact this.of_mul_left_right
    · rw [hα, show (m : ℝ) = 2 * b by rw [hb]; push_cast; ring]
      convert hrad using 2; field_simp; ring
  · right
    have hmo : Odd m := by
      rcases Nat.even_or_odd q with hqe | hqo
      · obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := hqe
        refine Int.not_even_iff_odd.1 fun hme => ?_
        have h2 : (2 : ℤ) ∣ m := hme.two_dvd
        have h2q : (2 : ℤ) ∣ (q : ℤ) := ⟨j, by rw [hj]; push_cast; ring⟩
        have := Int.isUnit_iff.1 (hcopm.isUnit_of_dvd' h2 h2q)
        omega
      · exact Int.not_even_iff_odd.1 fun hme => hpar ⟨hqo, hme⟩
    have hcop2 : IsCoprime m ((2 * q : ℕ) : ℤ) := by
      push_cast; exact (Int.isCoprime_two_right.mpr hmo).mul_right hcopm
    refine Set.mem_iUnion₂.2 ⟨2 * q, ⟨by omega, by push_cast; linarith, even_two_mul q⟩,
      Set.mem_iUnion₂.2 ⟨m, hcop2, hmem _ _ ?_⟩⟩
    rw [hα]; push_cast
    convert hrad using 2; field_simp; ring

proof_context.conclusion: From `Approx2 α y δ a q Q` writes α = m/(2q) + δ/(2y) with m = a + kq, and splits on parity: q odd with m even gives odd denominator q ≤ r, otherwise reduced denominator 2q ≤ 2r; so q ≤ r and |δ|q < δ₀r put α in 𝔐_{δ₀,r}(y).
